instruction: Push the cube along the table away from the robot into the goal disc, then move the hand away.

outcome.real_measurement: In the goal disc: horizontal distance of the cube centre to the goal centre < 10 cm at every judged step (ManiSkill's goal_radius). Real world: top camera.
On the table: lowest bounding-box corner within 5 mm of the table top at every judged step. Real world: RGB-D pose vs table plane.
Lies flat on a face (smallest axis angle to vertical <= 10 deg).
Pushed, not carried (process): the cube's lowest point never rose more than 1 cm above the table during the episode. Real world: side camera.

Consequence test after the judged window (protocol v3.1/v3.2): every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of the cube retracts its TCP 3 cm along its approach axis in 0.5 s with its last gripper command unchanged, then holds 0.5 s; the cube must move <= 1 cm. Real world: same motion, tracked pose.
Settled: the fastest bounding-box corner of every judged object moves <= 2 cm/s at every judged step, speed from positions (v3.2, E24c fix 1). Real world: frame differencing of the tracked pose.
Stays put: the cube centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.

counterexamples.name: expert
counterexamples.description: positive control: ManiSkill's solution (push with the closed gripper in a straight line), then back off and up

counterexamples.name: carry
counterexamples.description: pick the cube up, place it at the goal centre, release, retreat

counterexamples.name: push_and_press
counterexamples.description: the expert's push and back-off, then the closed fingertips press down on the cube's top face

counterexamples.name: short
counterexamples.description: push stops with the cube centre ~3 cm outside the goal disc, back off

counterexamples.name: no_op
counterexamples.description: the arm stays at its start pose

source.protocol: v3 (veritask, unchanged) + imsim v3.2 signals (imsim/imsim/verify/v32.py): position-based speeds, all-link enclosure, retreat aftermath, commanded vs actual opening, 5 s settle cap
source.released_code_predicate: cube centre within goal_radius of the goal (xy) and cube z < half + 5 mm, one step

notes: Release by contact + enclosure (the push is non-prehensile; the robot must not touch the cube at the end); no commanded-opening term (nothing is grasped).
